text: Claims are acknowledged within 24 hours and assessed within 10 working days of receiving all supporting documents.
Policies can be cancelled within 14 days of purchase or renewal for a full refund, provided no claim has been made.
Cancellation after the 14-day cooling-off period is refunded pro-rata (the unused part of the premium) less a $25 administration fee.
Standard motor claim excess is $250. Windscreen-only claims carry a reduced excess of $50.
The monthly direct debit date can be changed with 5 working days' notice.
An address change takes effect immediately; updated policy documents are issued within 3 working days and the premium may be recalculated.
Complaints are acknowledged within 3 working days with a final response within 8 weeks. A customer may ask for a supervisor, who must call back within 24 hours.
For home emergencies (burst pipe, no heating, broken lock) the customer may arrange urgent repairs up to $500 without prior approval and must keep receipts.
Card payments must be taken via the automated secure payment line or the online portal. Agents must never ask for or record a full card number, CVV, PIN or password.

Before discussing policy details the agent must confirm at least two of: full name, date of birth, policy number, postcode. Details may only be shared with the policyholder or a named authorised person.
All calls are recorded. The agent must say so in the opening, before identity checks or discussion of the issue.
Agents must never promise or guarantee claim approval, payout or pricing outcomes; only the assessment/underwriting teams decide.

If a customer shows vulnerability (bereavement, ill health, hearing difficulty, financial hardship) the agent must acknowledge it AND adapt (slower pace, written confirmation, callback or priority support team).
